# hallpass_agent (Resource)

An AI agent identity. The agent signs in to the gateway with its keys (see `hallpass_agent_key`); policy rules decide what it may reach. Destroying it deletes the agent: its access ends and its keys are revoked for good (a revoked key can never be registered again). Import with the agent ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_agent" "claude_sre" {
  name         = "claude-sre"
  description  = "Claude Code SRE assistant"
  groups       = ["sre-agents"]
  labels       = { team = "sre" }
  source_cidrs = ["10.20.0.0/16"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, shown to operators.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the agent is enabled. Disabling ends active access within seconds and cancels pending requests; enabling lets policy decide again.
- `groups` (Set of String) Groups of the agent, used by policy selectors.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the agent, used by policy selectors.
- `source_cidrs` (Set of String) Networks the agent may connect from, in canonical form (`10.1.0.0/16`). Empty means any source.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Agent ID (`agt_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Agent ID
terraform import hallpass_agent.claude_sre agt_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
